summary: All 3 new features validated end-to-end (backend + frontend + public portal). (1) Incident Seed: /api/ai-incidents returns 2 open incidents (AII-001 Prompt-injection on IT Support Copilot / AGT-002, AII-002 Shadow AI on Unknown Marketing GPT) for the admin org. On the Executive Overview, overview-incident-AII-001 row opens the universal risk-detail-modal with deep-dive-connectors showing 'IT Support Copilot · affected system' and 'AGT-002 · agent'. (2) Assurance Row Deep Dive: /app/control-assurance ca-recent-0 is now a BUTTON. Clicking it opens risk-detail-modal titled 'Kill Replay Drill · IT Support Copilot' with all 6 sections (deep-dive-scores 'Low RISK · Score 12/100', deep-dive-connectors 'Agent runtime · signed webhook' + 'AGT-002 · target agent', deep-dive-facets Outcome/Suspend/Resume/Receipt/Trigger/Run at, deep-dive-recommendations, compliance alignment NIST AI RMF MANAGE + ISO 42001 + SOC 2). No crash. This fully addresses the low-priority integration bug from iter104. (3) Share Detail Card: card-share-btn visible for admin, click POSTs /api/agents/runtime/card-share and renders inline card-share-result with QR + card-share-url (/card/<token>) + card-share-copy + card-share-open. Public portal at /card/:token loads WITHOUT auth showing card-share, card-share-title, card-share-scores, card-share-connectors, card-share-recommendations, card-share-download (href → /api/agents/public/card-share/{token}/card.pdf, returns application/pdf starting with %PDF, watermarked + integrity-sealed SHA-256). Invalid tokens → 404. Unauthenticated POST → 401/403. 5/5 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: agents.py card-share POST uses FRONTEND_URL env var to build the /card/<token> URL. If FRONTEND_URL is unset the URL would be '/card/<token>' (missing origin). In this env it is set correctly and the returned URL matches REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host. Consider falling back to request.headers.origin/host for defense-in-depth so the shared link is never broken.
public GET /public/card-share/{token} increments opens counter on every request — a bot / prefetch could inflate the count. Non-blocking, but worth throttling per IP if analytics matter.
_seed_incidents skips live_only orgs; the admin/owner org was pre-seeded directly (as noted). Endpoint remains idempotent for future non-live orgs — verified by only 2 incidents present.
PDF endpoint swallows watermark/seal exceptions with bare `except Exception: pass` and still returns the un-sealed PDF. Prefer logging so a silent breakage is observable.
